tools.name: issueRefund
tools.description:
Issue refund
Refund a small amount immediately. Use requestRefundApproval for anything over 10,000 JPY.
Effects: createObject Refund setting refundId, amountYen, reason, status; createLink refundOrder (Refund → Order); createLink refundTicket (Refund → Ticket).
Preconditions (the call is rejected otherwise): The amount must not exceed what is left of the order total after earlier refunds. The order must have been placed within the last 30 days. The amount must be 10,000 JPY or less; larger refunds need requestRefundApproval.
Side effects: The customer's original payment method is credited and a receipt is emailed.

tools.name: requestRefundApproval
tools.description:
Request refund approval
Ask a support lead to approve a refund over 10,000 JPY.
Effects: createObject Refund setting refundId, amountYen, reason, status; createLink refundOrder (Refund → Order); createLink refundTicket (Refund → Ticket).
Preconditions (the call is rejected otherwise): The amount must not exceed what is left of the order total after earlier refunds. The order must have been placed within the last 30 days.
Side effects: A support lead is asked to approve or reject the refund. No money moves until they do.

tools.name: escalateTicket
tools.description:
Escalate ticket
Effects: createLink ticketAssignee (Ticket → SupportStaff); modifyObject Ticket setting status, priority.
Preconditions (the call is rejected otherwise): Tickets can only be escalated to a support lead.
Side effects: The lead is notified with the escalation note.

tools.name: replyToCustomer
tools.description:
Reply to customer
Effects: modifyObject Ticket setting status.
Preconditions (the call is rejected otherwise): The ticket must not be closed.
Side effects: The message is emailed to the customer who raised the ticket.

tools.name: closeTicket
tools.description:
Close ticket
Effects: modifyObject Ticket setting status.
Preconditions (the call is rejected otherwise): No refund on the ticket may still be waiting for approval.
